content.title: Voice Honesty
content.essence: A synthesized stand-in must be labeled as synthesized — presenting it as the real voice is misrepresentation, however temporary or well-intentioned. Honesty about the seam, always.
content.lesson: Label synthesized voice honestly until true voice lands.
content.falsifier: An undisclosed stand-in causes no misled party in any observed case.
content.gate_ref: falsifier: synthesized voice without disclosure label → flag

content.title: Production Deploy Two-Saves
content.essence: A deployment record proves the deploy ran, not that the behavior works. Two saves: the deploy stamp AND the behavioral proof against the live deployment. Either alone is half a claim.
content.falsifier: Every stamped deploy, behaviorally tested live, works as intended.
content.gate_ref: deploy stamp without behavioral proof → not done (with B4)
